protocol.nativeSettings: Original engine and native controller law/base k/d/caps/gains/mass rules retained. Effective configured k/d may vary through original error-based torque cap and dynamic feedback; recorded requests are not delivered torques.
protocol.support: Fresh supported contact raw impulse projected upward. handO is forearm/palm proxy and shin is whole shin/knee proxy; no isolated palm/knee force or calibrated load.
protocol.limitations: Two deterministic game scenarios, not human samples. No pose/velocity teleport, new upright gain, threshold blocking stand, extra force or candidate adoption.
